title: Someone Is Outside Your Door

auditions.narratorText: You're home alone when your friend texts, I'm outside. Three knocks follow. You walk to the door and reach for the handle.
auditions.alexText: I'm still twenty minutes away. Whatever you do, keep the door locked.

script: You're home alone when your friend texts, 'I'm outside.' Three knocks follow. You walk to the door and reach for the handle. Then your phone rings. It's your friend. 'I'm still twenty minutes away.' Your hand freezes. From the hallway, his voice says, 'Open up.' You look through the peephole. Someone wearing his jacket stands perfectly still. Then your phone buzzes again. 'Whatever you do, keep the door locked.' Do you speak through the door, or stay silent?
